title: Candace Owen Dives Right Into The Kris Jenner & Kim Kardashian Back & Forth With Ray J, Says Kris Is Kim's Pimp [Watch]
htmlContent:
Candace Owens called Kris Jenner a "pimp" after Ray J alleged that Jenner had watched three sex videos he had shot with her daughter, Kim Kardashian, before choosing which one would be released.

Ray J and Kardashian, both 41 years of age, date from 2002 to 2006 and reportedly filmed the video during his birthday celebrations in Cabo San Lucas, Mexico, in 2004. The video was broadcast by Kim Kardashian, Superstar, in 2007.

Kardashian sued distributor Vivid Entertainment for invasion of privacy and for profits and ownership of the band, but dropped the lawsuit among reports of a multimillion-dollar settlement.

Jenner was a guest on the Late Late Show With James Corden, where she was asked about the rumors that she was the mastermind behind the release of the sex tape of Kim and Ray J during a polygraph test, and she said that she didn't put this in mention.

However, in a series of Instagram posts, Ray J aired out Kim and Kris by touching on the original agree between all parties & threaten to sue Corden, Jenner and Kardashian for defamation.

After seeing Ray J's Instagram Live last weekend, Candace Owens chimed in on her talk show.

The political commentator and activist went in on Jenner.

"Not only is that disgusting, but then that her plan worked. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire today, and she is, by the way, still selling sex," said Owens.

"I now hold the opinion that Kim Kardashian is a prostitute, and I am not going to edit this opinion," Owens said. "Kim Kardashian is a prostitute. Her mother is a pimp. Worse than a prostitute, Kim Kardashian is a corpse—she's a body without a soul."
